title: Count one byte in a buffer
summary: Count the newline bytes (0x0a) in a buffer of 1 KiB to 8 MiB of text or binary data.
notes: Inputs are hex strings, because fixtures are shared as JSON; every adapter turns them into bytes in prepare, before any timing. No npm or JSR package in the category offers this operation; only crates and standard-library baselines are measured.
